dossier_meta.paper: When Maximum Stable Set can be solved in FPT time
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is MIS (randomized) FPT or $W[1]$-hard in $H$-free graphs?
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the parameterized counterpart of the classical MIS dichotomy question. Alekseev's NP-hardness reduction does not transfer to $W[1]$-hardness, leaving a priori more candidate graphs $H$ for which the parameterized status is open. Dabrowski et al. initiated a systematic study of this question.
